name: Escitalopram
summary: Escitalopram is an SSRI antidepressant and the S-enantiomer of citalopram.
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: CYP2C19 and CYP3A4 mediate N-demethylation to S-demethylcitalopram, followed by further demethylation. The metabolites have weaker serotonin-reuptake effects; some parent and metabolites are eliminated in urine.
